first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and may also recover activation while avoiding an immediate pricing response that could weaken margins or customer quality. Verify onboarding's downstream adoption evidence and promotional pricing's long-term qualified-revenue economics before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: despite qualified-revenue lift, verified retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. Measure onboarding completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention guardrails before any broader rollout.
